description: The best air gap and parasitic length of a probe-fed stacked patch over driven boards of eps_r 2.2-10.2 and t = h sqrt(eps_r)/lambda 0.0185-0.0385, solved with the two-layer spectral MoM (otahub.num.patch_sdm.StackedPatch, BASIS_FULL; probe_vector) and the band finder (otahub.num.stacked.vswr_band). Lengths in free-space wavelengths at f0 = 2.4 GHz. The driven patch is the spec's (L, W for eps_r and h on their own); the parasitic is l2 long, W2 = W l2/L wide, in air (eps_r2 = 1) gap above it. band: the widest VSWR-2 band symmetric about f0 with a 20-ohm non-resonant reactance (band_range: 10-35 ohm) and a series element tuned for it, at the best of the probe positions 'feeds' (fractions of the driven half length). The matrix and probe couplings are solved at 'rs' f0 and splined (checked against the 0.025 f0 grid over 0.8-1.25 used by otahub stack: identical bands to 0.001 on the default and thick boards); every gap of 'gaps' is solved at once for each parasitic length (the gap enters only the layered Green's function). The search: parasitic lengths 0.02 apart around 0.355 until the best is inside, then 0.01 and 0.005 either side of the best. curves: per parasitic length solved, the band at each gap of 'gaps'. rule: the band against gap at the proposed rule's parasitic length (the rule's own gap added to the grid), and on the held-out boards at 0.005 either side of it. Sixteen boards fit the rules ('fit'), four are held out.
